text:
maya: Heads up — Deltaship container #57 moved from ETA 2024-10-05 -> 2024-10-11. This hits marketplace reserved SKUs and two Dedicated reservation buckets (DS-7831, DS-7832). Need quick reassign plan.

deltaship-bot: Manifest update: container 57 delayed due to port congestion. New ETD 2024-10-08, ETA 2024-10-11. Tracking: https://deltaship.local/track/57 :package:

gavin: ugh. can you post quantities by SKU, maya? also which marketplace commitments are timebound vs flexible?

ana_supply: (liaising from supply) quick numbers: DS-7831 = A100 x120, DS-7832 = A10 x40, marketplace reserved pool MKT-RED = A100 x60, MKT-BLUE = A10 x20. We have ~24 A100s in regional buffer (US-west) and 10 A10s.

maya: thanks. impact: we need to cover critical Dedicated customers first (DS orders), then preserve marketplace commitments where SLA says "shipped by".

liam: can we split DS-7831? partial delivery ok? customers on DS tier expect bandwidth, not full simultaneous capacity but they do expect their reserved throughput.

ana_supply: yes, Deltaship says split shipments possible but increases handling time. Proposed: release A100 x60 from the delayed container to EU customers on 10/11, and airlift A100 x30 from buffer to US-west on 10/07 for DS urgent workloads. Remaining A100 x30 will be staggered 10/11-10/13.

gavin: plan sounds reasonable. marketplace ops: throttle new reservations for MKT-RED by 40% until we confirm shipments. @sarah can we pause any public promos?

sarah: pausing promos now. will send customer comms template for affected marketplace purchasers and DS customers. propose offering small credit for those in the MKT-RED queue.

maya: putting proposed action list here: 
1) ana_supply -> confirm airlift cost + ETA for A100 x30 (owner)
2) gavin -> throttle marketplace reservations + update partner portal (owner)
3) liam -> flag DS customers for partial capacity & adjust autoscale defaults (owner)
4) sarah -> draft external comms + customer credits (owner)
5) maya -> coordinate update to on-call SRE if manifest changes runtime placement

```
manifest: DS-7831/DS-7832
container: 57
items:
  - A100: 120
  - A10: 40
buffer_uswest:
  - A100: 24
  - A10: 10
```

gavin: I'll also open a quick change request with the cloud marketplace partner to reassign 20 A100s from MKT-RED to a short-term hold pool we control. if accepted, that buys us time.

ana_supply: Deltaship replied: can air-freight 30 A100s with +48h lead, cost estimate sent to finance. They can also prioritize unloading for 40 A100s on arrival to speed ground transit.

liam: product note: will reduce burst autoscale cap to avoid customers pulling excess while we rebalance. will tag affected routes with "limit-temp" and set to 60% of normal.

sarah: drafting customer email now, will share in #customer-ops for review. suggestion: mention ETA change, what we're doing to remediate, and a one-time credit for impacted customers. :white_check_mark:

maya: timeline: updates every 2h until resolved. next update 1761112433 (~10m). owners: ana_supply, gavin, liam, sarah. thanks. :raised_hands:

deltaship-bot: Shipping note added to DS-7831: partial-release requested. Airlift option pending payment confirmation.

gavin: noted. I'll also block new marketplace seat allocations that would exceed current physical capacity.

ana_supply: payment okayed by finance, airlift booking confirmed, ETA for air shipment 2024-10-07 18:00 UTC. will follow up with tracking.

liam: implemented autoscale limit and route tag. monitor for any customer spikes.

sarah: shared customer draft, 3 reviewers: @gavin @maya @legal. sending in 20m.

maya: great. if anything changes dramatically ping me. otherwise we reconvene at next update.

gavin: thanks team. keeping marketplace partners looped. :lock:

sarah: small FYI — offer tiered credits: DS customers get higher priority + no credits; marketplace get 10% usage credit. open to feedback.

maya: agreed. DS customers we must avoid SLA breach. marketplace credits fine.

(END)
